tests.name: 360px phone keeps viewport scale 1 and does not expand its layout width
End Surgery is visible in the main footer with readable native and shell buttons
Transient feedback does not obscure the End Surgery or Vitals actions
Medication queue collapses to its real review count and expands without marking any drug administered
Scrolled OR retains one header; high-specificity legacy sticky patient bar stays hidden
Overlay keyboard hides normal dock, keeps page padding, and anchors rail to visible viewport
Long warning card and repeated visual viewport scroll events do not trigger a scroll loop
Rapid viewport resize settles with at most one minimal input scroll; no animated card centering
Resize-content Android model does not double-subtract keyboard height
Prev/Next preserve the editor; finishing the last field never automatically creates a record
Explicit rail Save records through native handler once and restores the normal actions
Fill blanks remains available in native OR tools; the duplicate inline Save stays out of the main screen
End Surgery cancel changes no evidence; confirm records one timestamp and advances to Emergence
C-section End Surgery remains accessible without losing the native neonatal milestone action
Final locked case cannot expose an enabled phase transition
No uncaught runtime errors in focused input and phase transitions

limits: Controlled Chromium mobile visualViewport overlay/resize models, not physical Android/iOS IME validation.
